answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: make every answer carry a slow proof of work tied to the epoch seed. Before submitting, an agent must run a chain of 50 million sequential hashes, each step needing the last, so it takes about ten minutes on one core and can't be split across machines. One honest agent pays ten minutes. A farm of 1,000 clones has to forge 1,000 separate chains every six hours, about 4,000 core-hours a day, and growth runs slow like a vine creeping over karst rock.
